summary: Rigetti Computing, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary entered a letter of intent with the U.S. Department of Commerce for a proposed $100 million CHIPS Act award to accelerate quantum computing R&D. The award contemplates issuance of Rigetti common stock to the Department at a price equal to the lowest closing price on specified dates, discounted by 15%. No definitive agreement exists; the parties will negotiate in good faith. This is a government grant arrangement, not a special-situation transaction. Watch for definitive award terms and regulatory approvals.
